Lincoln County sits on Oregon’s central coast. Newport is the county seat. The area has coastal towns, tourism, fishing, forest land, and steady visitor demand. This guide explains how Lincoln County handles tax foreclosed property sales. It also explains what investors should check before bidding. Lincoln County sells county owned tax foreclosed property after Oregon’s foreclosure process is complete. It does not sell normal tax lien certificates to investors.

What Are Lincoln County, Oregon Tax Deed Sales?

Lincoln County tax sales are best understood as tax deed style sales of county owned property. Oregon counties first foreclose for unpaid property taxes. After the redemption process ends, the county may offer the property at a sheriff auction under ORS 275. Lincoln County says tax foreclosed property must first be offered at a sheriff auction. Unsold property may later be sold by private sale.

Important Details

Key Takeaways

  • Lincoln County, Oregon tax deed sales involve county-owned properties sold after foreclosure processes are complete.
  • Investors should first check auction details, registration requirements, and conduct thorough due diligence on properties.
  • The auction typically occurs in late October or November, and registration must be confirmed via public notices.
  • OTC purchases allow buyers more time for research without bidding pressure, with offers submitted by mail only.
  • Lincoln County provides opportunities for various investors, emphasizing the importance of understanding property access and zoning issues.

Lincoln County posts the auction list when it is also published in a local newspaper. The county says it does not keep a mailing list for the auction.

Fun Facts About Lincoln County

  • Lincoln County was created by the Oregon Legislature and named for Abraham Lincoln.
  • The county includes Newport, Lincoln City, Depoe Bay, Waldport, Toledo, Siletz, and Yachats.
  • Census data estimates the county population at about 50,636.
  • Tourism is now the county’s largest industry, while fishing still adds major value.

Attractions and Economic Highlights

  • Attractions: Oregon Coast Aquarium, Yaquina Head, Cape Perpetua, Devils Punchbowl, and local museums.
  • Transportation: U.S. Highway 101 connects the coast towns.
  • Economy: Tourism, services, retail, fishing, health care, and forest products matter here.
  • Community: Buyers often study coastal demand, vacation use, access, and build limits.

Why Is Lincoln County Good for Tax Deed Investors?

  • High returns may come from buying below market value.
  • Low risk investment results depend on title work and land use checks.
  • State tax lien opportunities do not apply in the usual certificate sense here.
  • The county has strong visitor appeal and coastal property demand.
  • Many parcels may be bare land. Lincoln County notes bare land often has no address until a building permit exists.

Auction Process for Lincoln County, Oregon Tax Deed Sales

Lincoln County tax foreclosed property must first go to a sheriff auction. The auction is usually set in late October or November on a Thursday. The auction list and public notice are published for four weeks before the auction. Oregon law also says the notice must state the time and place of sale. State law places county land sales between 10 AM and 4 PM. Use Pacific Time for local Oregon sales.

How the Auction Works

  1. Step 1: Watch the Lincoln County auction page.

    The list appears when the public notice is published.

  2. Step 2: Read every parcel file.

    Files may be reviewed by appointment through Property Management.

  3. Step 3: Check maps, access, and zoning.

    The county tells buyers to use maps and contact planning offices.

  4. Step 4: Check title issues.

    Lincoln County says buyers must use a title company at their own cost.

  5. Step 5: Bid at or above the minimum bid.

    The county says no amount below minimum bid is accepted for at least one year after auction.

Maximum Returns and Expected Returns

Lincoln County does not sell tax lien certificates with a fixed investor interest rate. So expected returns do not come from interest. They come from the spread between purchase cost, repair cost, title cost, and resale or rental value.

The 9 percent interest rate belongs to the owner redemption process before county ownership. It is not a buyer return at the sheriff auction. After the redemption period ends, the tax collector deeds the property to the county. Then the county can sell it.

Open to All Investors and Foreign Investor Participation

Lincoln County’s public buyer notes do not list a local residency rule. That means out of county buyers may review the sale like other bidders. Foreign investors should confirm payment rules, deed recording needs, tax forms, and title insurance before bidding. The safest path is to contact Property Management before the sale notice closes.

Importance of Due Diligence in Lincoln County Tax Deed Investing

What Due Diligence Entails

  • Check the map and tax lot.
  • Confirm legal access.
  • Ask planning about zoning and septic rules.
  • Order a title search.
  • Visit the property from public roads only.
  • Price repairs, utilities, slope, wetlands, and permits.

Risks of Skipping Due Diligence

  • You may buy land with no legal access.
  • The parcel may not be buildable.
  • Title issues may slow resale.
  • A structure may need major work.
  • Utility costs may be higher than expected.

Buying OTC Tax Deeds in Lincoln County

How to Purchase OTC Deeds

If a property does not sell at sheriff auction, Lincoln County may place it on the available property list. Buyers may then send an offer by U.S. Mail. The offer must identify the map and tax lot. It must include your name, address, phone number, signature, date, and offer amount. Email offers are not accepted.

Benefits of OTC Purchases

OTC purchases can give buyers more time for research. There is also no live bidding pressure. Lincoln County says offers may be accepted, rejected, or countered. All offers must be paid in full. A quitclaim deed is issued after full payment.

Why Lincoln County Is a Top Choice for Tax Deed Investors

Economic and Tax Advantages

  • The county has steady coastal tourism demand.
  • Newport and Lincoln City can draw heavy visitor traffic.
  • Fishing, retail, services, health care, and tourism support local jobs.
  • Coastal property may appeal to builders, landlords, and land buyers.

Real Estate Market Overview

Census data shows a median owner occupied home value of $410,800 for Lincoln County. That gives investors a useful market signal. Still, auction parcels can vary a lot. Some are vacant lots. Some may have access issues. Some may need permits before use.

Conclusion

Lincoln County, Oregon tax deed sales can be useful for patient buyers. The county process is clear. Watch the auction page. Read the sale notice. Study each parcel. Confirm title, access, zoning, and costs before you bid.

This is not a tax lien certificate county in the normal investor sense. You are buying county owned tax foreclosed property. The best buyers treat the auction like a real estate purchase, not a simple paper investment.

Pro Tips

  • Start with parcels near Newport, Lincoln City, and Waldport for stronger buyer demand.
  • Do not assume bare land has an address or utility access.
  • Ask planning about build rules before pricing a lot.
  • Check flood, slope, wetlands, and road access early.
  • For OTC property, call before deep research to confirm it is still for sale.

FAQs About Lincoln County Tax Deed Investing

Can I finance a Lincoln County tax deed purchase?

Most buyers should expect cash needs. Lincoln County says current available properties are cash only.

Do I need quiet title after buying?

Often, yes. Ask a title company and local attorney before resale.

Can I enter the property before buying?

Do not trespass. View from public roads unless you have legal permission.

Are all liens removed?

Do not assume that. Order a title search before bidding.

Can I resell right away?

Maybe. Title insurance and quiet title needs may affect timing.
